ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevents non system administrators from changing the First Name, Last Name, or Salutation on Externally Mastered Contacts that are managed by MDM.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Id <> '00ed00000017Iob' && $Profile.Id <> '00ed00000019yKB' && RecordTypeId = '012d0000000wzM4', ISCHANGED( FirstName) || ISCHANGED (LastName) || ISCHANGED (Salutation))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only System Administrators can change names on External Mastered Contacts.
